The '''evil spirit''' is the [[boss]] in [[Rum Deal]]. It only attacks with [[Melee]], so turning on [[Protect from Melee]] or [[Deflect Melee]] is sufficient in protecting a player from most damage. High-levelled players should not worry about this battle, as the spirit is rather weak, has no weakness, and has few life points for its level.

A two-handed weapon can kill it relatively quickly. Poison is not necessary, as the spirit is immune to its effects. If a player is above level 80 and uses Protect from Melee, there is little need for [[food]].

==Habitats==
The [[Braindeath Island]] Brewery. 
Players must have made sufficient progress in [[Rum Deal]] to be able to fight it. 
Players are able to fight it when they bang their [[Holy Wrench]] on the "possessed" [[brewing control]]s.
